name: Opsgenie: alert on case escalation
description: When a case is escalated to a tier, create an Opsgenie alert addressed to a team. The alert alias is the escalation's dedup key, so a later close closes exactly this one.

params.label: Opsgenie team
params.help: Name of the Opsgenie team to alert (letters, digits and . _ : / - only).

secrets.name: OPSGENIE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Opsgenie API integration key (sent as `Authorization: GenieKey <key>`) with create and close rights.

setup:
## Opsgenie side
1. Create an **API** integration in Opsgenie (Settings > Integrations) with create and close access. Store its key as `OPSGENIE_API_KEY`, allowed host = the API host you chose.

## How it works
- Runs when a case is escalated (trigger `case.escalated`): `POST https://<API host>/v2/alerts` addressed to the team, `alias` = `sochub-case-<case id>-esc-<escalation id>`.
- Priority follows the case: critical → P1, high → P2, medium → P3, anything else → P4.
- Install *Opsgenie: close on escalation closed* so closing the escalation closes the alert.


## Ack to accept
To let an acknowledgement in Opsgenie accept the escalation in SOC Hub, open **Settings → Integrations → Escalation paging**: the card shows the inbound URL to paste into Opsgenie (an incoming webhook integration, action *Acknowledge*). It is tied to this tenant and keeps working until you rotate it there.

body.message: {{ ('[SOC Hub] Case #' ~ case.id ~ ' escalated to ' ~ trigger.changes.escalation.group.name ~ ': ' ~ case.title) | truncate(130, True) }}
